parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM user group.

parameters.name: NewComments
parameters.description:
The new description.

The description can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: NewDisplayName
parameters.description:
The new display name of the RAM user group.

The name can be up to 24 characters in length.

parameters.name: NewGroupName
parameters.description:
The new name of the RAM user group.

The name can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims update-group --new-comments '测试团队' --new-display-name Test-Team --new-group-name Test-Team --group-name Dev-Team --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ims UpdateGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName 'Dev-Team' --NewDisplayName 'Test-Team' --NewGroupName 'Test-Team' --NewComments '测试团队'
